assay_type: biochemical kinase inhibition concentration-response using ADP-Glo luminescent ADP detection
system: Cell-free recombinant DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit (P78527); DNA/Ku activation requirements are unresolved in the packet.
readout: Luminescence from ADP-Glo ADP detection, normalized to controls as a measure of P78527 kinase activity; not a cell-viability readout.

steps.instruction: Prepare a compound dilution series for CHEMBL104468 with matched vehicle and reference/background controls. Set the top concentration only after range-finding; do not infer potency from the packet.
steps.parameters: top_concentration_uM: unresolved/null (no packet support); dilution_factor: 3 (provisional assumption); n_points: 10 (provisional assumption); replicates: 3 (provisional assumption); vehicle_fraction: unresolved; match vehicle across wells (provisional assumption)

steps.instruction: Combine CHEMBL104468, P78527, substrate and ATP. Include DNA/Ku activation if required by the P78527 preparation; exact activation conditions are unresolved.
steps.parameters: enzyme_concentration: unresolved; substrate_concentration: unresolved; ATP_concentration: 10 uM (contextual support from CHEMBL1243970; not direct for CHEMBL104468 or ADP-Glo); reaction_time: unresolved; temperature: unresolved; DNA/Ku activator: unresolved

steps.instruction: For ADP-Glo, stop the kinase reaction, deplete residual ATP, perform the ADP detection reaction, and measure luminescence. Kit-specific volumes and times are unresolved.
steps.parameters: reagent_volumes: unresolved; depletion_time: unresolved; detection_time: unresolved

steps.instruction: Normalize against vehicle and no-enzyme controls, fit a concentration-response curve, and report uncertainty and limitations. Do not report an IC50 outside the tested range as a determined value.
steps.parameters: fit_model: four-parameter logistic (provisional assumption); acceptance_criteria: curve should span inhibition with lower/upper plateaus and IC50 within tested range; otherwise report qualified/not determined; report CI and assay limitations (provisional criteria)

controls: Vehicle control at matched final vehicle fraction (exact tolerance unresolved)
Reference DNA-PK inhibitor positive control (identity and concentration unresolved)
ADP-Glo detection/background controls as required by the kit (unresolved)
rationale: The question asks for biochemical inhibition of P78527, so the ordered kinase-prepare, kinase-react, kinase-detect, analyse cards are appropriate; cell-viability cards are excluded because they would not establish biochemical target inhibition. ADP-Glo measures kinase-produced ADP as luminescence and is a biochemical activity readout. The only packet-supported concentration parameter is contextual ATP at 10 uM from a different DNA-PK radioactive assay (CHEMBL1243970), so it is used only as a starting point, not as a CHEMBL104468-specific fact. The dilution factor, point count, replicates and 4PL fit are provisional design assumptions, not sourced measurements. No IC50 is predicted.
limitations: No packet evidence supports a top concentration for CHEMBL104468; top_concentration_uM is left null and must be set by range-finding or external source before execution.
ATP 10 uM is contextual from CHEMBL1243970, a radioactive DNA-PK assay, and is not direct support for CHEMBL104468 or the ADP-Glo format.
Enzyme concentration, substrate identity/concentration, DNA/Ku activation, reaction time, temperature, reagent volumes, depletion time and detection time are unresolved.
Dilution factor, n_points, replicates and 4PL fit are provisional design assumptions, not sourced facts.
ADP-Glo detects ADP and can be affected by assay artifacts; no-enzyme and detection controls are required.
Biochemical inhibition of P78527 does not establish cellular viability effects or target-specific causality in cells; cell-viability cards were intentionally not selected.
